## Checklist
- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Every new claim has a source
- [ ] Nothing tells a reader to start, stop or change a treatment
- [ ] No new cookies or trackers; nothing a visitor types leaves their browser
- [ ] Usable by keyboard, labelled, readable in both themes
- [ ] Privacy page and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if needed
- [ ] No patient data or personal details
